name: io.github.seanebones-lang/deadbolt
title: DeadBolt by NextEleven
description: Local execution gate: fixed deadlines, operator-only controls, read-only setup and readable denials.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.setupMode: Two read-only setup and bundle-verification tools; no active protection until configured.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.protectionBoundary: Protects connected dispatch routes. Not an OS sandbox; cannot cancel running actions.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.renewal: New roots default to supervisor renewal; explicit activity mode and stored modes remain supported. Neither moves the fixed deadline.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.validationBoundary: Installed stdio/effect tests are separate from historical RC3 Cursor model evidence; no certification or marketplace acceptance.
